sod2 is a novel Na+/H+ transporter, which has a unique mode of operation, which is different from other Na+/H+ transporters.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sod2 encodes an Na+/H+ exchange activity that is conserved in S. pombe and S. cerevisae and that it can functionally complement the loss of the S. cerevisie ENA1/ PMR2 sodium pump.
the sod2 gene encodes a sodium-proton antiporter that is active in the plasma membrane of S. pombe and S. cerevisae, and is involved in the regulation of internal sodium concentrations.

the sod2 Na+/H+ exchange gene is functional in both S. pombe and S. cerevisae.
